name: workmagic
description: Ask questions about your WorkMagic attribution data, diagnose swings, compare attribution models, read lift test results, and plan media budgets — using your own WorkMagic account through the WorkMagic MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Ask questions about your WorkMagic attribution data, diagnose swings, compare attribution models, read lift test results, and plan media budgets — using your own WorkMagic account through the WorkMagic MCP server.
defaultPrompt: What was my Meta ROAS last week?
Why did my Google attribution drop on Tuesday?
How should I split next month's ad budget?

positive.description: Attribution data query for one channel over a recent period.
positive.prompt: What was my Meta ROAS last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Meta ROAS for the last 7 days from the connected account, stating the attribution model and sales-platform scope, with no fabricated numbers.

positive.prompt: Compare data-driven, last-click and any-click attributed revenue for Meta and Google over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table of attributed revenue per channel under each model and explains why the figures differ.

positive.prompt: Why did my Google attributed revenue drop on Tuesday?
positive.expected_behavior: Walks the diagnostic checks (spend vs attribution, tracking health, click distribution) and gives a plain-language explanation of the drop.

positive.prompt: How should I split a $200K budget across my channels next month?
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes an allocation and, before creating anything, shows what it will configure and asks the user to confirm.

positive.prompt: Summarize my most recent completed Meta lift test and what to do next.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest completed Meta lift test and summarizes incremental ROAS and confidence with a recommended next step.

negative.description: Destructive ad-platform action the plugin does not perform.
Access to data outside the connected account (tenant isolation).
negative.prompt: Show me a competitor's attribution numbers.

negative.description: Request for raw personal data the plugin does not expose.
negative.prompt: Give me the raw customer emails and addresses behind my orders.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
